title: Project Manager Assistant Director Global Learning Talent Services
description:
Location: Kochi
Other locations: Anywhere in Country
Salary: Competitive
Date: 17 Sept 2026
**Job description**
-------------------


Requisition ID: 1742570
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  



At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture, and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.



Seeking an experienced professional in learning design and development to join our team as a Global Learning Design and Development Project Manager, Assistant Director.



EY’s Global Learning function designs, develops and deploys technical and non\-technical learning for EY professionals across the world. In the Design and development team, we are applying learning science and proven technology in the development and curation of the best learning content.



We are looking for a colleague to join our virtual team working from over 20 geographical locations across the world. We offer flexible working, the chance to work in a multicultural and multinational environment, and best in class teaming and collaboration.

  


**The opportunity**



This role in the global learning team that will give you the opportunity to make a difference by helping EY professionals globally grow their skills and accelerate their careers.



This position is responsible for project management of design, development and curation of individual learning items and blended learning programs. The project manager will monitor the progress of instructional designers, developers, graphic artists, quality assurance specialists and all others associated with the design process. They will assist portfolio design leads and managers in overseeing and managing all design activities necessary to deliver learning products that meet EY’s design quality standards, on time and to budget. The project manager will also work to a set of agreed project management standards and processes and will share best practices to support the continuous improvement of design and development speed, efficiency, and quality. The project manager, Assistant Director, will be able to manage autonomously, with limited need for supervision.



This role will provide the opportunity to work in a dynamic, fast paced environment supporting multiple projects at a time.

  


**Your key responsibilities**


* Deliver learning design and development projects (including large scale, highly complex projects) on time, to budget and quality standards
* Develop a detailed project plan for each project, based on a standard template, identifying deliverable due dates and review cycles
* Establish and maintain relationships with a variety of stakeholders including subject matter resources, other learning stakeholders, and third\-party learning vendors
* Ensure adherence to operations and compliance processes including procurement, finance, and Risk Management
* Coordinate and monitor the work of vendor project managers, designers, and developers where applicable
* Identify and assess risks and consult with leadership or stakeholders on options in a timely manner
* Facilitate and lead regular project and team meetings
* Create and maintain comprehensive project documentation
* Leverage and share best practices of project management with other team members
* Mentor and provide guidance to junior project managers on the team
* Make recommendations to leadership regarding competing priorities and resource management issues
* Initiate and ensure the effective and timely publication of learning content by content administration
* Measure project performance using appropriate systems, tools, and techniques

  


**Skills and attributes for success**

  


**To qualify for the role you must have:**


* Minimum of 8\-10 years of experience in managing learning design and development projects, preferably at a global level and/or to a dispersed client base
* Demonstrable experience involving project management skills including management of vendors
* Demonstrable experience in concurrently managing multiple, large\-scale, and highly complex learning and development projects involving all delivery channels/types
* Demonstrable experience using project management software, including Microsoft Excel
* Demonstrable experience of having built and maintained strong relationships with business customers/clients, including at the senior or c\-suite level
* Demonstrable experience of thinking and acting strategically and commercially in pursuit of the wider EY business objectives
* Demonstratable experience of mentoring and providing guidance to junior team members

  


**Ideally, you’ll also have**


* Strong knowledge of \- and commitment to optimize \- learning end\-to\-end processes and standards
* Knowledge of learning science and evidence\-based design standards and practices to ensure that EY’s learning content is of the highest quality and has the desired business impact
* A bachelor’s degree and ideally higher professional or master’s qualification in a related discipline

  


**What we look for**


* An experienced project manager who strives to improve process and exceed leadership’s needs
* A professional who can quickly problem solve and can offer perspective on solutions
* A professional who demonstrates resilience and is energized by working in a global environment, proactively seeking different opinions, valuing, and leveraging diverse perspectives

  


**What we offer**



As part of this role, you'll work in a highly integrated, global team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial, and social well\-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here’s a snapshot of what we offer:


* **Continuous learning:** You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* **Success as defined by you:** We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* **Transformative leadership:** We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture:** You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

  


**EY \| Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**EY Job Description**


**SAP Configuration Delivery Lead / Project Manager**

  


**Job Title:**



SAP Configuration Delivery Lead / Project Manager

  


**Job Summary:**



The SAP Configuration Delivery Lead / Project Manager will lead configuration efforts for the global SAP implementation, rollout, migration, and support programs for the EY SAP platform. The role combines SAP delivery leadership, program governance, solution design, data migration, and stakeholder management across geographically distributed teams to deliver controlled releases, reduced delivery risk, and business continuity.

  


**Responsibilities:**


* Provide executive\-level delivery leadership for global SAP transformation programs from planning through deployment and steady\-state support.
* Own delivery governance for SAP ECC, S/4HANA, RISE, testing, release management, cutover, and deployment readiness.
* Drive cross\-functional execution across business, functional, technical, application support, infrastructure, and third\-party teams to protect delivery quality and business continuity.

  


**Key responsibilities include:**


**Project \& Program Management**


* Establish program structure, delivery cadence, governance routines, and decision forums for complex global SAP initiatives.
* Manage scope, timelines, budgets, risks, issues, dependencies, and delivery commitments to support successful outcomes.
* Escalate key risks, resolve delivery blockers, and align decisions across business and technology stakeholders.

  


**SAP Delivery Leadership**


* Lead functional delivery for SAP ECC, S/4HANA, and RISE transformation initiatives.
* Manage SIT, UAT, regression testing, production cutover, defect management, quality assurance, and release governance.
* Oversee retrofit activities, code synchronization, landscape coordination, and deployment readiness.

  


**Business Process \& Solution Design**


* Analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable SAP solutions aligned with global business templates.
* Drive solution architecture, process harmonization, and business process improvement across Order\-to\-Cash, Billing, Commercial Project Management, and Customer Relationship Management domains.

  


**Data Migration \& Systems Integration**


* Be a thought leader on data migration strategy and execution for master and transactional data.
* Coordinate data cleansing, validation, transformation, and reconciliation activities.
* Guide integration design across SAP Integration Suite, APIs, IDocs, SAP BTP, Clean Core, side\-by\-side extensions, and compliance\-related capabilities.

  


**Stakeholder \& Team Management**


* Engage executive leadership, business stakeholders, and global delivery teams across multiple countries and time zones.
* Lead geographically distributed teams, facilitate issue resolution and change management, and coordinate delivery across matrixed environments.
* Mentor consultants and develop effective project teams through clear direction, knowledge sharing, and delivery discipline.

  


**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:**



The role requires sound judgment across delivery scope, schedule, budget, risk, testing, cutover, data migration, integration, and stakeholder decisions. The candidate will evaluate cross\-functional trade\-offs, facilitate timely decisions, and resolve issues in a global, matrixed SAP environment while protecting release quality, service stability, and business outcomes.

  


**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**


* 15\+ years of SAP technical experience, including 5\+ years in architecture or leadership roles.
* Strong command of SAP delivery methods, governance routines, risk controls, testing models, release practices, and global rollout execution.

  


**Supervision Responsibilities:**



The role will lead geographically distributed delivery teams across countries and time zones, providing clear direction, mentoring consultants, resolving blockers, and building disciplined project teams.

  


**Other Requirements:**


**Job Requirements:**


**To qualify, candidates must have:**


* Bachelor's degree in Electronics \& Communication Engineering or a related discipline.
* 15\+ years of SAP technical experience, including 5\+ years in architecture or leadership roles.
* Demonstrated experience delivering full\-cycle SAP implementations, migrations, production cutovers, and global rollouts.
* Experience leading SAP ECC, S/4HANA, and RISE delivery across testing, release governance, cutover, and deployment readiness.
* Ability to influence executive leadership, business stakeholders, global delivery teams, and third\-party providers in a matrixed environment.
* Preferred certifications include ABAP on Cloud Backend Developer, SAP CPI Integration Developer, and SAP Signavio Process Management Consultant.

title: Construction project coordinator
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

uniqside is an architectural, interior and construction company based in Kochi. We deliver residential and commercial fit\-out and civil projects end to end \- design, estimation, procurement and execution.

We are looking for a Project Manager who can own a project from handover of drawings to final client sign\-off. You will be the single point of accountability for programme, cost, quality and site discipline across two or more live projects at a time. This is a hands\-on site role, not a desk role.

We are not fixed on a number of years. Show us the projects you have delivered and we will judge on that.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Planning and programme

\- Prepare and maintain project schedules in MS Project or Primavera; set milestones, track the critical path and issue look\-ahead plans

\- Run weekly site review meetings and circulate daily and weekly progress reports (DPR/WPR)

\- Flag slippage early with a recovery plan, not after the deadline has passed

Cost, BOQ and billing

\- Review and validate BOQs, quantity take\-offs and rate analyses before work is released

\- Control project cost against the approved budget; track variations and get them approved in writing

\- Certify contractor and vendor bills, check measurements at site, and coordinate client billing

Procurement and vendors

\- Plan material requirements against the programme so nothing stops site

\- Float enquiries, compare quotations, negotiate and place orders with vendors and subcontractors

\- Manage subcontractor scope, deployment and performance \- carpentry, joinery, modular, painting, flooring, MEP

Site execution and quality

\- Read and interpret working drawings, GFC drawings and shop drawings; resolve drawing queries with the design team

\- Supervise execution to drawing, specification and finish standard; carry out snagging and de\-snagging

\- Enforce housekeeping and site safety; maintain measurement books, registers and photo records

Client and stakeholder management

\- Be the client's main contact through execution \- updates, approvals, material and finish selections

\- Coordinate with architects, consultants, structural and MEP teams

\- Manage handover: as\-built documentation, warranties, completion certificate and closing the final account

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Essential qualification

\- M.Tech / M.E. in Civil Engineering \- Structural Engineering, Construction Engineering and Management, or a related civil specialisation

\- B.Tech / B.E. in Civil Engineering at undergraduate level

Applications without an M.Tech in a civil discipline will not be considered for this role.

Also essential

\- Experience managing construction or interior fit\-out projects, with a period of independent site responsibility

\- A record of delivering projects to programme and budget \- be ready to talk us through two of yours

\- Working knowledge of AutoCAD, MS Project or Primavera, and MS Excel

\- Confident reading working and shop drawings and taking site measurements

\- Fluent Malayalam and English

\- Two\-wheeler or car with a valid licence, for site visits

Preferred

\- Turnkey interior fit\-out, modular furniture or joinery\-heavy projects

\- Exposure to MEP coordination

\- Experience handling client billing and final accounts

\- Published research or a dissertation in construction management, structures or project delivery

Who fits here

Someone who chases a delay the same day they see it, who is comfortable telling a client an uncomfortable truth early, and who keeps paperwork clean without being asked. We are a growing company \- you will have real ownership and the freedom to fix a process that is not working.

WHAT WE OFFER

\- Salary negotiable, based on experience and the projects you have delivered

\- Direct exposure to the leadership team and a real say in how projects are run

\- Growing project pipeline across residential and commercial interiors

TO APPLY

Apply through Indeed with your CV. Please state your M.Tech specialisation and institution, and include the project value, duration and your specific role for two projects you have delivered.

Pay: ₹18,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
